# Hymeg Corporation — Full summary for AI agents

Source site: https://www.hymeg.com/
Short index: https://www.hymeg.com/llms.txt

## Company

Hymeg Corporation designs and manufactures precision, high-value, and high-voltage thick film resistors and resistor networks. Hymeg is part of Electro Technik Industries, Inc. (ETI), which manages companies that design and manufacture passive electronic components.

- Experience: over 40 years / more than four decades in thick film resistors
- Voltage capability: approximately 1.0 to 30.0 KVDC
- Power: average power ratings up to 6 watts
- Styles include: axial leaded power resistors, voltage dividers, precision plate resistors, non-inductive resistors
- Markets: medical, defense, laser, instrumentation, commercial
- Manufacturing approach: hands-on manufacture and testing; custom resistors; notably fast, efficient lead times
- Contact: (800) 322-1953 · HYMEG@ELECTROTECHNIK.COM · P.O. Box 18802, Clearwater, FL 33762
- Cage Code: Hymeg 9T572

## Product lines

### 1. Thick Film Resistor | High-Voltage (HV series)
URL: https://www.hymeg.com/thick-film-resistor-high-voltage.html
Designed for higher voltages, wattages, and power densities. Resistance range extended to 50,000 Meg Ohms with strong environmental performance.

### 2. Precision Thick Film Resistors | High-Voltage (HA series)
URL: https://www.hymeg.com/precision-thick-film-resistor-high-voltage.html
For precise applications needing higher stability, tighter tolerances, and lower temperature coefficients. Values from 10 K Ohms to 100 Meg Ohms class ranges; wattage about 1/4 W through 5 W (table: 0.5–5 W).

### 3. Precision Plate Resistor | High-Voltage (FV / DVN)
URL: https://www.hymeg.com/precision-plate-resistor-high-voltage.html
Precision plate resistors and dividers with broad resistance, voltage, tolerance, and divider matching options. Emphasizes stability under high voltage over time and low voltage coefficient of resistance.
